text: June nineteen sixty-two. High above Alcatraz's cellblock, three inmates engineered an escape out of raincoats.
asr: June 1962. High above Alcatraz's cell block, three inmates engineered an escape out of raincoats.

text: Over months, they stole more than fifty rubberized coats, cutting and stitching them into a six by fourteen foot hull.
asr: Over months, they stole more than 50 rubberized coats, cutting and stitching them into a 6 by 14 foot haul.

text: To seal the seams watertight, they clamped the rubber against hot prison steam pipes, vulcanizing the joints.
asr: To seal the seams watertight, they clamp the rubber against hot prison steam pipes, vulcanizing the joints.

text: For inflation, they converted a musical concertina into a hand-pumped bellows, driving air through a single red valve.
On the night of June eleventh, with hand-carved wooden paddles, they pushed off into San Francisco Bay.
asr: On the night of June 11th, with hand-carved wooden paddles, they pushed off into San Francisco Bay.

text: The raft held. By morning, only the tide remained.
